tool_descriptions.code_mode.run: Run JavaScript in this task's persistent V8 room. The prelude namespace contains only the explicitly bound facade exports named by this task's context artifacts. Use returned exact application/tab identities and observation/geometry references. Top-level bindings and closures survive later cells in this same live context. Emit values with text(value), images with image(value), and progress with notify(value). Evaluating an expression or awaiting a returned value does not emit it. If an export has a documentation() method, pass its result to text(); await is allowed. Do not assume every export implements documentation(). There is no console or Node.js; console.log and nodeRepl.write are unavailable. Nested tools execute through granted artifact routes and resolve the same Promise only after admitted results, including any required human consent. A yielded response gives cell_id; use the advertised Wait method for retained output. A second Run while a cell is active refuses. Do not call internal resume or supply tool results. No ambient imports, filesystem, network or unbound SDK is provided. A lost or changed context refuses without replaying source.
tool_descriptions.code_mode.wait: Read this task's retained cell output, completion or current frontier using the exact cell_id. Internal admitted continuations and readiness do not consume this output. Wait may advance the same live cell; nested tools and required human consent resolve through their original artifact routes. Do not supply result or approval arguments; a lost context refuses without source replay.
